title: PRESSER | Santiago Trouet, Chris Beard & Roman Siulepa - Nicholls Postgame (11-17-26)
text: I want to wish uh Nicholls the best of luck this season. I I don't I don't know their coach to my knowledge. It's the first time we met before the game with the handshake line, but um AD there made a good hire. That guy um that team has got an identity. We played well tonight in a lot of ways. That team was forcing over 18 turnovers a game. We took care of the ball for the most part. Couple sloppy ones late. Um, you know, I thought like I don't know if you guys kind of felt what was going on in the game, but in the second half they weren't really playing the scoreboard. They were working to get better and they kind of had long extended offensive possessions putting pressure on us that have patient defensive possessions and we we fell for it. You know, we played even with them early second half. Um, but I was impressed with their kind of setup and I think those guys have a more than competitive team in their conference and we'll be pulling for them. Um, I want to thank the students again. um this four game home stand uh before we go to Maui. Uh the four times our students were able to see their team this year before the Thanksgiving break. Just super appreciative of all the students that continue to come out uh including with the game gets out of hand a little bit on the scoreboard. A lot of the students stuck around and create a good environment all the way to the end. So really really appreciate them. Um also appreciate the season ticket holders. A lot of our season ticket holders don't live in Oxford. I know there's a lot of road trips uh for people to come to see a weekday game and so it doesn't go unnoticed around here. We appreciate it. Um I thought tonight guys were dialed in. Obviously defensively we did some really good things in the first half. Um offensively a little frustrating at halftime just the points we have on the scoreboard but a lot of it was finish shots. We were getting a zone shots. We did not finish at a high percentage and it's why we didn't get to the free throw line in the first half as well. So give the guys credit. They made some adjustments offensively at halftime. Was proud of our players tonight and look forward to, you know, going to Maui uh next week. Any questions for these players? >> For for both of you, just the defensive uh effort tonight was obviously noteworthy. You held them to nine first half points. What was what led to that? >> Uh it's a key emphasis of our team. It's our identity just being able to go out there every game and sort of keep teams more turnovers and and do our part. So, I think that's just scout being ready, being looked in, and then getting out there and executing on the court. >> Yeah, I feel like we found we found what what we'd like to do is just turn teams over. We're number one in the country right now. Turning teams over. We just wanted to make sure we don't relax in this game before going to Maui and we just we just stepped out there and did it, but I feel like we could have done we could have kept it going in the second half, too. >> Being such a new team and having a defensive identity, how have you guys worked together on and off the court to build that chemistry to be able to play team defense like this? I mean, you just got every team, you just got to build the chemistry outside the court. Obviously, on the court, I feel like it was quick. We all just clicked. We all we we want each other to do good, but just off the court, we try to have as many team dinners, have as many team activities. I feel like we've been doing a good job as just connecting off the court. >> Yeah, we're just coach collectively, so it's easy when you get on the court. No disrespect to the teams you play at all, but how eager are you guys to see what you look like against, you know, Clemson, either Washington or BYU, and whoever you play on Wednesday out in Maui? >> We're itching. Um, once we get out there, we just want to make a statement, go out there, put our best foot forward, and and do what we going there to do. So, I think we're just itching to get out there and play. >> Yeah. I mean, we haven't received a single vote for the top 25 yet. >> Uh, so we just want to go out there and just go earn our respect. uh make them give give us our respect and yeah that's it.
